ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), NOT( OR( CASE(TEXT(Stage__c), "Kickoff Scheduled", 1, "Gathering Info", 2, "Implementation", 3, "QA / Review", 4, "Go Live", 5, "Post-Launch Review", 6, 0) - CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)), "Kickoff Scheduled", 1, "Gathering Info", 2, "Implementation", 3, "QA / Review", 4, "Go Live", 5, "Post-Launch Review", 6, 0) = 1, AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)) = "QA / Review", ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Implementation") ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Onboardings move forward one stage at a time. The only step back allowed is QA / Review → Implementation.
